question: What is the meaning of human toxicological effects carcinogenic in relation to environmental performance?
description: Human toxicological effects carcinogenic refers to the potential harm caused to human health by exposure to substances that can cause cancer. In the context of environmental performance, it implies assessing the risk of carcinogenic substances released into the environment, which could pose a threat to human health. This assessment is part of the life cycle assessment (LCA) process, which evaluates the environmental impacts of a product or process throughout its life cycle, including potential human health effects.
